why: the old behaviour: a change of the ground colour holds only the background colour, so a gradient ground is never held
a glyph colour would be held alone when its gradient ground cannot be
an element with no background image read would count as resting on a gradient
a gradient at one width only would make the image the ground at every width
a picture ground would be held through a gradient setting
the ground would be held only where the block's look lists the gradient itself, which calibration never records
